title: Phone call with Dr. Patel
transcript: Dr. Patel said your blood pressure has improved and is now normal. Please take Metformin 500mg every morning with breakfast. Your cholesterol test results were better than last time. Your next appointment is on Friday at 10am. Remember to bring your blood sugar log to the appointment.

title: Call with Mom
transcript: Mom said she will visit on Sunday afternoon. She asked me to call Priya tomorrow to confirm the family lunch. Mom said a package is expected and the delivery is arriving tomorrow. Please pick up fresh vegetables and milk before Sunday.

title: Pharmacy visit
transcript: The pharmacist said my prescription refill is ready. I need to pick up my vitamins from the pharmacy today. The pharmacist reminded me to take Vitamin D every night after dinner.
